<!--
Follow CONTRIBUTING.md and other repository guidance.
Keep responses proportionate; use "Not applicable" with a reason.
Report only checks actually performed and identify unverified work.
Do not include secrets, personal data, or confidential security details.
-->

## Summary

<!-- Explain the problem, the change, and the resulting behavior. -->

## Related work

<!-- Link relevant issues, discussions, or existing plans.
Use "Closes #..." only when the issue is fully resolved. -->

## Validation

<!-- List commands or review steps, environment, results, and evidence.
Describe statistical/reference cases, numerical checks, and reproducible comparisons.
State data assumptions and limitations for changed estimates.
Identify failures, checks not run, and remaining limitations. -->

## Impact and risk

<!-- Describe API, fitted-model, prediction, or supported-environment changes.
Identify backward-compatibility and documentation implications. -->

## Documentation and follow-up

<!-- Identify documentation, examples, or changelog updates, or explain why none apply.
Record remaining work without claiming it is complete. -->

## Author checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I provided validation evidence and disclosed incomplete checks.
- [ ] I checked for unintended sensitive content and considered security/privacy.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation or explained why no update is needed.
